run_release_utils_cli: run the release utils CLI with --release-type major to compute the next version
run_release_utils_update: run the release utils CLI with --release-type patch --update-version to update version.txt
get_next_version: get the next semantic version tuple, version string, and tag for a given release type
find_version: find and read the current version string from a version file path
update_version: update the fairseq version.txt file with a new version string
